classification_rules: block never had any contact record in the episode -> no_valid_contact
last contact tick: exactly one record at the max contact time -> single_contact_<role>
last contact tick: several records at the max contact time, all one role -> multi_point_same_robot_<role>  (referee labels this 'simultaneous' -> no score)
last contact tick: both roles at the max contact time -> genuine_two_robot_contest
